title: A Controlled-Perturbation Protocol for Validating Synthetic-Tabular-Data Metrics
summary: Code and reproducible environment for a paper that injects graded, controlled distributional perturbations into real tabular datasets to establish ground truth for what synthetic-data fidelity metrics actually detect. Its transfer-gap study (coda.py) trains SDV's GaussianCopula, CTGAN and TVAE synthesizers on real data and scores the outputs with SDMetrics' QualityReport, using the SDV/SDMetrics stack as both synthetic-data generators and an evaluation metric under test.
evidence: coda.py:56-61 imports GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer from sdv.single_table and instantiates/fits them
